subproblem.title: Admissibility and change of variables for the dilated pair (λ^{−m}η_*μ, ξ(a + λ·))
subproblem.statement: Let P, m ∈ ℕ, a ∈ ℝ^P (Euclid P) and λ > 0, and let η := dilation a λ, η(y) = −λ⁻¹a + λ⁻¹y = λ⁻¹(y − a). Let μ be a measure on ℝ^P (Borel σ-algebra) with μ(K) < ∞ for every compact K ⊆ ℝ^P. Let ξ : ℝ^P → Λ_m(ℝ^P) (MultiVector P m, the continuous linear functionals on m-covectors) be μ-a.e. strongly measurable with |ξ(x)(α)| ≤ |α| (|α| = covectorEuclideanNorm α) for μ-a.e. x and every m-covector α. Put μ₂ := ofReal(λ^{−m})·η_*μ (Lean: ENNReal.ofReal (lam⁻¹ ^ m) • Measure.map (dilation a lam) μ) and ξ₂(y) := ξ(a + λy). Then: (a) μ₂(K) < ∞ for every compact K ⊆ ℝ^P; (b) ξ₂ is μ₂-a.e. strongly measurable; (c) for μ₂-a.e. y, |ξ(a + λy)(α)| ≤ |α| for every m-covector α; (d) for every set S ⊆ ℝ^P and every map ω : ℝ^P → Λ^m(ℝ^P) (a DifferentialForm; no regularity assumed), ∫_S ξ(a + λy)(ω(y)) dμ₂(y) = λ^{−m}·∫_{η⁻¹(S)} ξ(x)(ω(η(x))) dμ(x) (Bochner integrals).
subproblem.lean_statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (a : Euclid P) (lam : ℝ) (μ : Measure (Euclid P)) (ξ : Euclid P → MultiVector P m), 0 < lam → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → μ K < ∞) → AEStronglyMeasurable ξ μ → (∀ᵐ x ∂μ, ∀ α : Covector (Euclid P) m, |ξ x α| ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm α) → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → (ENNReal.ofReal (lam⁻¹ ^ m) • Measure.map (dilation a lam) μ) K < ∞) ∧ AEStronglyMeasurable (fun y => ξ (a + lam • y)) (ENNReal.ofReal (lam⁻¹ ^ m) • Measure.map (dilation a lam) μ) ∧ (∀ᵐ y ∂(ENNReal.ofReal (lam⁻¹ ^ m) • Measure.map (dilation a lam) μ), ∀ α : Covector (Euclid P) m, |ξ (a + lam • y) α| ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm α) ∧ ∀ (S : Set (Euclid P)) (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) m), ∫ y in S, ξ (a + lam • y) (ω y) ∂(ENNReal.ofReal (lam⁻¹ ^ m) • Measure.map (dilation a lam) μ) = lam⁻¹ ^ m * ∫ x in dilation a lam ⁻¹' S, ξ x (ω (dilation a lam x)) ∂μ
subproblem.natural_proof:
Source: parent proof, steps 1, 3 and 7. These steps show that η is a homeomorphism and measurable equivalence, that (λ^{−n}η_*μ_X, ξ_X(a + λ·)) is admissible, and the change of variables for the restricted integrals. Here they are extracted for an arbitrary pair (μ, ξ) in degree m and an arbitrary set S and form ω.
Notation: η := dilation a λ, so η(y) = −(λ⁻¹a) + dilationCLM P λ (y) = −λ⁻¹a + λ⁻¹y; c := ENNReal.ofReal(λ^{−m}), where λ^{−m} means (λ⁻¹)^m; μ₂ := c·η_*μ; ξ₂(y) := ξ(a + λy).
1. η is a homeomorphism. Since λ > 0, λ⁻¹ ≠ 0. Let e be the homeomorphism y ↦ λ⁻¹y (Homeomorph.smulOfNeZero λ⁻¹ _) followed by the translation z ↦ −λ⁻¹a + z (Homeomorph.addLeft (−(λ⁻¹a))). For every y, e(y) = −λ⁻¹a + λ⁻¹y = η(y): unfold dilation and dilationCLM, using (λ⁻¹ • id)(y) = λ⁻¹y. So e = η as functions (funext). Consequences: (i) η is a measurable embedding of ℝ^P with its Borel σ-algebra (Homeomorph.measurableEmbedding, transported along e = η); (ii) for every compact K, η⁻¹(K) = e⁻¹(K) is compact (Homeomorph.isCompact_preimage).
2. Inverse identity. For every x ∈ ℝ^P: a + λ·η(x) = a + λ(−λ⁻¹a + λ⁻¹x) = a − (λλ⁻¹)a + (λλ⁻¹)x = x, since λλ⁻¹ = 1 (simp with smul_add, smul_smul and λ ≠ 0). Hence ξ₂(η(x)) = ξ(x) for all x, i.e. ξ₂ ∘ η = ξ.
3. Proof of (a). Let K be compact. Since η is a measurable embedding, (η_*μ)(K) = μ(η⁻¹(K)) (MeasurableEmbedding.map_apply, valid for every set). So μ₂(K) = c·μ(η⁻¹(K)) (Measure.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul). By 1(ii), η⁻¹(K) is compact, so μ(η⁻¹(K)) < ∞ by hypothesis. Also c = ofReal(λ^{−m}) < ∞ (ENNReal.ofReal_lt_top). A product of two finite elements of [0, ∞] is finite (ENNReal.mul_lt_top), so μ₂(K) < ∞.
4. Proof of (b). For the measurable embedding η, a map G is η_*μ-a.e. strongly measurable iff G ∘ η is μ-a.e. strongly measurable (MeasurableEmbedding.aestronglyMeasurable_map_iff). For G := ξ₂, step 2 gives G ∘ η = ξ, which is μ-a.e. strongly measurable by hypothesis. So ξ₂ is η_*μ-a.e. strongly measurable. Multiplying the measure by the constant c preserves a.e. strong measurability (AEStronglyMeasurable.smul_measure), so ξ₂ is μ₂-a.e. strongly measurable.
5. Proof of (c). Let p(y) be the statement ∀α, |ξ(a + λy)(α)| ≤ |α|. For the measurable embedding η, (∀ᵐ y ∂η_*μ, p(y)) ⟺ (∀ᵐ x ∂μ, p(η(x))) (MeasurableEmbedding.ae_map_iff). By step 2, p(η(x)) is the statement ∀α, |ξ(x)(α)| ≤ |α|, which holds for μ-a.e. x by hypothesis (filter_upwards, then rewrite with step 2). So p holds η_*μ-a.e. Every η_*μ-null set N is μ₂-null, because μ₂(N) = c·0 = 0. Hence p holds μ₂-a.e. (Measure.ae_smul_measure).
6. Proof of (d). Fix S ⊆ ℝ^P and ω : ℝ^P → Λ^m(ℝ^P), and let G(y) := ξ(a + λy)(ω(y)) ∈ ℝ.
(i) Restriction commutes with scalar multiples of measures: μ₂⌞S = c·((η_*μ)⌞S) (Measure.restrict_smul).
(ii) For every function F and every measure ν, ∫F d(c·ν) = c.toReal·∫F dν (integral_smul_measure). No integrability is needed: if F is not integrable, both sides are 0.
(iii) c.toReal = λ^{−m}, because λ^{−m} = (λ⁻¹)^m ≥ 0 (ENNReal.toReal_ofReal with positivity).
(iv) Change of variables along the measurable embedding η, valid for every function and every set with no integrability hypothesis: ∫_S G d(η_*μ) = ∫_{η⁻¹(S)} G(η(x)) dμ(x) (MeasurableEmbedding.setIntegral_map).
(v) By step 2, G(η(x)) = ξ(a + λη(x))(ω(η(x))) = ξ(x)(ω(η(x))).
Combining (i)–(v), with smul_eq_mul: ∫_S ξ(a + λy)(ω(y)) dμ₂(y) = λ^{−m}·∫_{η⁻¹(S)} ξ(x)(ω(η(x))) dμ(x). This is (d), and together with (a)–(c) it proves the theorem. ∎
proof_key_steps: η = dilation a λ coincides with the homeomorphism (y ↦ λ⁻¹y) followed by (z ↦ −λ⁻¹a + z), so η is a measurable embedding and preimages of compact sets are compact.
Inverse identity a + λη(x) = x, hence ξ(a + λ·) ∘ η = ξ.
(a): μ₂(K) = ofReal(λ^{−m})·μ(η⁻¹K) < ∞ by MeasurableEmbedding.map_apply and compactness of η⁻¹K.
(b), (c): transfer a.e. strong measurability and the a.e. bound through MeasurableEmbedding.aestronglyMeasurable_map_iff / ae_map_iff and the inverse identity, then through the scalar multiple.
(d): restrict_smul, integral_smul_measure, toReal(ofReal λ^{−m}) = λ^{−m}, MeasurableEmbedding.setIntegral_map and the inverse identity.
